name: ENACT
summary: 从第一人称交互评测具身认知的前向与逆向世界建模基准，提供问答、回放和 HDF5 数据。
summaryEn: An egocentric-interaction benchmark for forward and inverse world modeling with QA, replay, and HDF5 data.
scale: Forward and inverse dynamics tasks with scalable replay datasets
scaleZh: 前向与逆向动力学任务及可扩展回放数据
organizationsZh: 西北大学 MLL 实验室
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT；数据许可见发布页
access: ENACT QA, HDF5, replay, and segmented datasets available
accessZh: ENACT 问答、HDF5、回放和分段数据可用
verdict: 明确把前向和逆向世界建模作为评测目标的基准
verdictEn: A benchmark explicitly targeting forward and inverse world modeling
wmNote: 动作到未来状态、未来观测到动作的双向任务直接对应世界模型核心能力。
wmNoteEn: Action-to-future-state and future-observation-to-action tasks directly test core world-model abilities.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - mll-lab-nu/ENACT: ENACT is a benchmark that evaluates embodied cognition through world modeling from egocentric interaction. It is designed to be simple and have a scalable dataset. · GitHub
evidence.statement: Official protocol explicitly evaluates future-state sequences from actions and inverse action sequences, with download and generation instructions.
